We don't need data to know that a gov't shutdown would be disastrous, but here's some anyway:

🚨786,686 TX women & kids are at risk of losing critical nutrition assistance under a Republican-caused shutdown

Almost eight hundred thousand. That's an entire Congressional district.

Thanks @SecVilsack for sounding the alarm. My @HouseGOP colleagues just don't seem to get it: a shutdown helps no one & only starves American children.

Over 7,000,000 Americans rely on WIC for nutrition.  A government shutdown = a WIC shutdown.https://t.co/jcqati8tpM

✅H.R. 5610 - Establishes the Commission on Equity and Reconciliation in the Uniformed Services

✅H.R. 5757 - Extends certification periods for the special supplemental nutrition program for women, infants, and children

✅H.R. 5760 - Establishes a climate resilience workforce

I'll keep saying it: an entire congressional district's worth of women and children are about to lose their WIC access in Texas.

To these nearly 800,000 Texans, I'm sorry our Republican House Majority is more concerned about the President's family than your everyday nutrition. https://t.co/mIjEWPe1Aw

Years later after the start of the HIV & AIDS epidemic, the disease continues to disproportionately impact the Latinx community.

Today, I’m raising awareness of the impacts HIV has on the Latinx community & encouraging testing, prevention, and treatment. #NLAAD https://t.co/MATMDTe1W2

Today is #WorldAIDSDay, a day to renew our fight to end the HIV epidemic across the globe.
